title: Warm Crispy Canadian Rice Skewers
description: A festive Canadian dish featuring crispy rice and vegetable flavors, perfect for any occasion. This Whole30-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and cooked to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the Canadian rice, vegetable stock cube, coconut oil, khao khuat rice seasoning, and salt until well combined.
Thread small handfuls of the rice mixture onto the soaked bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each portion.
Place the skewers on the preheated robata grill and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the skewers are cooking, mix together the chopped green onions and sesame seeds in a small bowl.
Once the skewers are done, brush them with a little bit of coconut oil and sprinkle with the green onion and sesame seed mixture.
Serve the Warm Crispy Canadian Rice Skewers hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
